transcript.question: Is Cameron Coscia's roster management actually building The Stinky Faggots into a contender, or is his nine-move, league-most churn on waivers a sign he doesn't trust the roster he drafted?

hotSeat.why: Nina Sharpe is favorite on them (+72), Curtis Vaughn is neutral on them (+9)

sides.mel-diaper: Nine waiver moves and counting is a GM who never trusted his own draft board and is patching a foundation that was never solid.
sides.reggie-banks: The Stinky Faggots are 5-and-3 with a top-four scoring output on the year, so whatever Cameron Coscia is doing on the wire is clearly working.

turns.speaker: curtis-vaughn
turns.text: Good evening. The Stinky Faggots dropped a 6.1-point nail-biter to Chodie mcgruber this week, 123 to 116.9, and still sit 5-and-3 with the league's busiest waiver wire behind them. So: is Cameron Coscia building a contender or just churning bodies? Mel, you're up first.

turns.speaker: mel-diaper
turns.text: NINE. NINE pickups, league-most, and the roster still lost by 6.1. Cameron Coscia drafted Bijan Robinson at PICK TWO and he's out there claiming Will Reichard for $0 and the 49ers D/ST for $0 in Week 8. That is not contending, that is REDECORATING. I say The Stinky Faggots finish outside the top two seeds — no better than third — and I want the waiver wire CONFISCATED.

claim.text: The Stinky Faggots finish no better than 3rd in the final standings

turns.speaker: reggie-banks
turns.text: Cute draft, Mel. Now the record: 5-and-3, 1,094.2 points, FOURTH in the league in scoring. Nine pickups isn't churn, that's a man WORKING. Rico Dowdle, waiver-era grinder, went 32.4 and 33.9 in back-to-back weeks. Cam Skattebo, pick 146, RB10 on the year. I say The Stinky Faggots finish top two. Prove me wrong with a third-place finish or worse. GIVE THAT MAN HIS FLOWERS.

claim.text: The Stinky Faggots finish in the top two seeds — 1st or 2nd — in the final standings

turns.speaker: mel-diaper
turns.text: FOURTH in scoring?! Reggie, they scored 105.4 in Week 7 and LOST. They scored 116.9 this week and LOST. That's TWO losses under 120 from a roster with Bijan Robinson at pick two and Josh Allen at 22. And $76 of $100 still sitting in the budget — NINE pickups and he spent TWENTY-FOUR DOLLARS. That's not working the wire, that's window shopping with the cart empty.
factsCited: B6 The Stinky Faggots $76 of $100 left, 9 pickups

managerMentions.evidence: NINE pickups and he spent TWENTY-FOUR DOLLARS. That's not working the wire, that's window shopping with the cart empty.

turns.speaker: nina-sharpe
turns.text: Class, check the row: fourth in points scored, 1094.2, that part's real. But nine pickups for $24 spent, with $76 sitting unused — that's partly supported. He's active on the wire but not paying for it. I'll flag my own soft spot for his lineup cards before you say it: even I can't make $76 unspent look aggressive.

turns.speaker: reggie-banks
turns.text: Nina, I'll take partly supported and bank the rest. But Mel — you want cheap? Bijan went 35.8 in Week 6 and Dowdle 33.9 in the same afternoon, 185.4 points, a 45-point beatdown of Moisty Loins. That's the roster you're calling a foundation problem. And Week 8: Josh Allen 24.2, Waddle 20.9, Shakir 20.8, three starters over 20 and they lost by 6.1. Losing that close isn't a broken build. SCOREBOARD.

M20 - Week 8 T2 123 vs T8 116.9, margin 6.1

managerMentions.evidence: That's the roster you're calling a foundation problem.

turns.speaker: mel-diaper
turns.text: SCOREBOARD?! Then read the WHOLE card, Reggie. Week 8 they left 19.7 on the bench and lost by 6.1. Week 7, seventeen point eight benched, lost by 11.3. TWO GAMES, TWO BENCHES, TWO LOSSES. And the Week 8 wire answer was a $0 kicker and a $0 defense with SEVENTY-SIX DOLLARS in the drawer. That's not a foundation, that's a tarp. Dex, tell me what's actually reported.

turns.speaker: reggie-banks
turns.text: Dex just read it: $0 kicker, $0 defense. And Mel calls that a problem. Nineteen-point-seven benched is the LOWEST bench total in that whole Week 8 slate — 63.9 for Moisty Loins, 38.6 for IM NOT GAY. The Stinky Faggots start their best. Meanwhile Team Rive burned $90 on Woody Marks and sits 4-and-4. THAT is window shopping. Five-and-three. I'll wait.

turns.speaker: curtis-vaughn
turns.text: Let's settle the seed math. Walt, historical parallel — a 5-and-3 team, fourth in scoring, nine cheap pickups. Where does that team actually finish?

turns.speaker: walt-brennan
turns.text: The record only goes back to this season, so I won't pretend I've seen this exact team before. What I see is fourth in scoring, a 6.1-point loss, and a budget nobody spent. That's not a contender or a churn artist, it's a landlord who owns a good building and won't fix the boiler. My verdict: Reggie's closer, because the scoreboard says fourth, but Mel's right that $76 unspent isn't a plan.
factsCited: B6 - Stinky Faggots budget $76 remaining, 9 acquisitions, $24 spent

And the one bid that mattered all season, Kyle Monangai, he offered ZERO DOLLARS and got outbid by Prolapsed Peehole for TWO. TWO! With $76 in the drawer! I want that budget audited on live television.

turns.speaker: sam-ortega
